Can we talk about how adorable this dress is?!

I'm absolutely in love with this strawberry & floral print! The classic Peter Pan collar, tiny pearl buttons, and full pleated skirt make it even sweeter!

We made this beauty using our newly updated soft woven cotton, giving it that lovely structured look while keeping it comfortable for little ones. For boutique owner, we can support you customizing the prints, colors, collars, and little details to match your brand's own style!

Whether you're dreaming of a vintage-inspired collection or something a little more playful, we'd love to help bring your ideas to life!
